summary: On paper this one is close: Green Bay's best edge is to win through the air (Green Bay ranks 11th in EPA per dropback, +0.18), while Dallas's best counter is to finish drives (Dallas ranks 3rd in red-zone TD rate, 65%). Under center, Jordan Love ranks 11th of 23 in EPA per dropback and Dak Prescott ranks 13th; x-factor: CeeDee Lamb gets 27% of Dallas' targets and 35% of its air yards, and Green Bay's pass defense ranks 9th. The model favors Dallas at 50%, mostly on rushing matchup (3.8 pts) and offensive injuries (0.5 pts).
